coaching.headline: We won the majors 27 to 8 and the towers 8 to 2, converting five of eight won fights into a prize within 90 seconds.
coaching.team: The draft read favorable in two of five lanes: Kira over Legion, and Lt. Belica over Renna late. The jungle read even, and the duo lane (Kira+Phase) also read ours by game's end, with zero duo deaths before minute ten to their three. Feng Mao lost the offlane to Riktor from the start, and Riktor killed him twice in the first seven minutes; at minute 8 we traded Fangtooth for their Mini Prime, an even split of the map's first prizes. After that we won every fight but one: an even 1-1 skirmish at 13.5 that cost us our Outer Tower. Five towers, two Inhibitors and the Core fell across the back half of the game, and we finished eight towers to two. The only blemish: both Outer Towers we lost, at 13.5 and 20.1, fell with Feng Mao already dead to Riktor each time, even though the surrounding fights were won or even. Objective damage finished 67,651 to 7,729 ours.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: We also traded even skirmishes at 6.8 and 13.5; outside of those, we won every fight, and five of our eight won fights converted into a prize within 90 seconds.
coaching.whatWorked: The duo lane dominated: zero deaths before minute ten against their three, first blood, and first Fangtooth, while Kira finished 17 kills on zero deaths.

perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Kira's lane read ours the entire game against Legion, and she converted it into 17 kills on zero deaths, team-high 40,114 damage to heroes. Her only previous film on Kira was a 4/7/7 loss; this 17/0/6 win is a clear step up.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Phase did the support job clean: 16 wards placed against the enemy support's 4, zero deaths before minute ten for herself or the carry, and 14,284 healing. The build finished the full Marshal-Enra's Blessing-Galaxy Greaves core. It is the second straight clean support game after the same standard set in an earlier film.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Aurora's jungle matchup read ours early and theirs late against Scarlett, and she led the match in objective damage at 30,227. Her only death came in an even 1-1 trade at our Outer Tower, not a solo catch, breaking from a recent film on Argus with three solo catches.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Lt. Belica's lane read even early, then ours the rest of the way, against Renna, adding 24,101 damage to heroes. Both of his deaths were solo catches, by Riktor at 23.7 and by Scarlett at 25.9, continuing a pattern from a recent film with three solo catches on Zarus -- neither cost an objective in a game already decided.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Feng Mao lost the offlane to Riktor all game and died to him four separate times. Both towers we lost, at 13.5 and 20.1, fell with him already dead. His build carried none of the three winning-core items, continuing a run of incomplete builds, and he never answered Riktor's magic damage with resist.

21.call: Lt. Belica, Kira, and Feng Mao won a 4-0 fight with Aurora not credited and converted it into their Inner Tower -- the fight didn't need a full group credited to pay off.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Kira ran Solaris and Imperator from the winning core but swapped the third slot, Ashbringer, for Ruination and Terminus -- the gap never got tested since she finished 17-0 regardless.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: Phase added Windcaller before completing the Marshal-Enra's Blessing-Galaxy Greaves core at Galaxy Greaves (~29m) -- all three core items landed by full build, nothing to question here.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.eternal: The engine doesn't model support Eternals (Exarch, Aion, Lotus, Marrow, Nihil, Weald, Pilow, Satariel), so no Eternal read is offered for Phase.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.build: Aurora skipped Elafrost and Gaia Greaves from the winning jungle core for Spirit of Amir and Dynamo, and carried no magic resist into a comp that was three-fifths magical -- her only death still came in an even trade, so nothing here is proven costly.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Lt. Belica was one item short of the winning core, missing only Noxia, running Tainted Scepter instead -- close enough that the two late solo catches explain this game more than the build does.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: Feng Mao ran a completely different build from the winning core, none of the three items (Mindrazor, Omen, Painweaver), with Manta Scythe and Tainted Trident instead, and never built resist against Riktor's magic damage -- the losing matchup already explains most of this, but the build gave him nothing to answer it with.

focus.title: The lost offlane kept leaking towers inside fights we were winning
focus.evidence: Both towers we lost, at 13.5 and 20.1, fell with Feng Mao already dead to Riktor, including the 19.6 fight we actually won 2-1 -- while the rest of the map ran away with it at 8 towers to 2.
focus.action: Once the offlane is already down for the game, send someone to cover that tower window specifically instead of trusting the overall kill lead to hold it.

threats: Chain-CC risk (3 hard-CC abilities, ~2.5s of lockdown): Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Mercy poke → stack Vengeance → Shadow Glide reposition → Purge ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Vengeance and shred with the channeled Purge
ourKits.playWith: peel so she can channel Purge safely
ourKits.playAgainst: interrupt/CC her during Purge; punish her short dash cooldown

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
ourKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

ourKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
ourKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Reaping Dash → Hamstring slows → Safeguard spellshield → Earth Shatter execute
ourKits.winCondition: trade with the spellshield up and execute low targets with Earth Shatter
ourKits.passive: permanent power on unique hero takedowns
ourKits.playWith: setup that holds a target for the execute
ourKits.playAgainst: bait Safeguard's spellshield before committing the key CC

enemyKits.combo: Maco Gift! (heal ally / hurt enemy) → Maco Fly! slam → Maco Strike! charged line ult
enemyKits.winCondition: poke and heal-flex while landing the charged ult
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge the charged Strike; pressure his low survivability

enemyKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
enemyKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
enemyKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
enemyKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
enemyKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

enemyKits.combo: Riplash pull → Shock Therapy silence → Skewer suppress ult
enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and chain silence+suppress for a guaranteed kill
enemyKits.playWith: burst that deletes his pulled/suppressed target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect Riplash range — stay spaced; cleanse/QSS the suppress
